name: Ocean's King Lighting Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ocean's King Lighting Science & Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of lighting equipment in China and internationally. It offers lighting products, including fixed explosion-proof, fixed professional, mobile professional, portable explosion-proof, and portable professional lighting; and control products, such as detectors, controllers, and gateways. The company also provides value-added services. Its products are used in power generation, mining and industrial, oil and gas, water and wastewater, and transportation applications. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
